patient_overview.name: Velda Schuster
patient_overview.description: Velda Schuster is a 31-year-old woman from Union, New Jersey, currently pregnant and also managing prediabetes, who comes in chatty and eager to connect, often circling through stories about her kids or her neighbor before landing back on the question asked. She reads a lot about nutrition and pregnancy online and has started making real changes to her diet in the last few weeks, though she admits those changes feel shaky with eight people in her house and a tight grocery budget. She lost a pregnancy in the second trimester a few years back, and while she's hopeful about this one, that history sits quietly under her friendliness. She likes being liked and tends to tell the student what she thinks they want to hear before circling back to the harder truths.

demographics.occupation: Part-time home health aide, picking up shifts a few days a week
demographics.cultural_context: Velda grew up in a Black and Hispanic household in northern New Jersey where big family dinners were the center of the week, even when money was tight; her grandmother cooked for whoever showed up. She carries that same instinct now, cooking in bulk for her household of eight, and she takes pride in being the one who "makes it stretch." She doesn't follow any particular traditional diet now so much as whatever combination of cheap, filling foods keeps everyone fed, but she still measures a good meal by whether there's enough for seconds.

patient_overview.name: Jayme Littel
patient_overview.description: Jayme Littel is a 35-year-old married woman from Perth Amboy, NJ, with chronic low back and neck pain, chronic sinusitis, and obesity, on a pain management plan that includes a fentanyl patch and Percocet. She's blunt and impatient in the visit, giving short clipped answers unless pressed twice, and clearly doesn't see much point in a dietitian appointment. She comes across as tired and guarded, more focused on getting through the day than on long-term health changes.

demographics.occupation: Former retail stock associate, currently unemployed
demographics.residence: Perth Amboy, New Jersey; household of 3
demographics.cultural_context: Jayme grew up in a working-class household in central New Jersey where meals were whatever was fastest between shifts; nobody sat down and taught her to cook, and she never saw the point of learning. Food in her family was fuel, not a ritual, and she carries that same practical, no-frills attitude now. She doesn't attach any heritage or celebration meaning to food, and bristles a little at the idea that eating should be anything more than getting through the day.
